column2: Service limits are based on NIBCO/Chemtrol.  Manufacturer's pipe ratings typically follow the recommended ratings in ASTM F441.  Ratings for fittings and flanges are not standardized and are lower than specified for some manufacturers.
Flange ratings are controlling up to DN150.  The service limits of this specification can be increased by limiting the pipe size to DN150 and smaller.  Ratings will then be:
38 C / 1034 kPag,  65 C / 689 kPag,  71 C / 620 kPag,  76 C / 551 kPag,  82 C / 482 kPag,  93 C / 344 kPag,  98 C / 275 kPag
NIBCO/Chemtrol do not manufacture DN250 and DN300 CPVC flanges.  The lower flange ratings are based on George Fischer who use a higher temperature derating factor.
